nodes.title: Canonical triple fourth-vector wall
nodes.claim: max f = W = (88 + 3*sqrt(6))/100 after the canonical product triple {Z2(x)Z3, X2(x)Q0, Y2(x)Q1}
nodes.known_weaknesses: No external independent rerun yet (open brick B1).

nodes.title: Explicit algebraic witness attaining W
nodes.claim: An explicit algebraic unit vector v* attains f(v*) = W exactly (18 overlap identities, democratic counts).
nodes.known_weaknesses: Lower bound only; pairs with the upper-bound certificate C.global-wall.

nodes.title: Exact PSD global-wall certificate (independently checkable)
nodes.claim: max f <= W on the unit sphere, via an exact PSD/Veronese certificate Q (degree-4 Sym^4 coefficient matrices) over Q(sqrt2,sqrt3) with deterministic closure over the triple's 432-element symmetry group, checked by a stdlib-only verifier against a stored Q (does not rebuild it).
nodes.certificate_sha256_of: the DECOMPRESSED contents of evidence/global-wall-certificate-Q-exact.json.gz (the bundle's SHA256SUMS pins the .gz at 116f8e63a0c1686f9be732f10ba45317e011030a7fc27cb5a700f77ec9a16725)
nodes.known_weaknesses: Verifier checks a stored Q; an independent re-parse / re-implementation is open (bricks B2, B3).

nodes.title: Local interval certificate around v*
nodes.claim: f(u) < W for every unit u with 0 < theta(u,v*) <= r0 = 111/12640, by exact rational interval arithmetic.
nodes.known_weaknesses: Local (ball of radius r0), not global; the global statement is C.global-wall.

nodes.title: Product-ceiling law
nodes.claim: f_prod = (d-a)/(d-1), with an unaligned/conditioned extension that drops the alignment hypothesis.
nodes.known_weaknesses: Law is exact in the aligned model; the aligned-room test at d=24 is float (node D.d24-exact).

nodes.title: T1 second-wall attainment
nodes.claim: An explicit algebraic witness attains W(T1) = (1163 + 38*sqrt(3))/1265 exactly; minpoly 6325x^2 - 11630x + 5329.
nodes.known_weaknesses: Attainment only; the matching global upper bound is open (node D.t1-global / brick B5).

nodes.title: Cross-room defect identity d12/d24
nodes.claim: 11*(1 - W12) = 23*(1 - W24), explained structurally by the lift-law lemma (stabilizer-code compression).
nodes.known_weaknesses: Identity is exact; the individual room walls W12, W24 are 60-digit (no closed form yet).

nodes.title: d=16 board room construction
nodes.claim: 17 MUBs via the general dual-basis symplectic spread over GF(16); exact 255-dimensional tiling, residual 0.
nodes.known_weaknesses: Construction/tiling result; not a d=6 wall.

nodes.title: Two-board combinatorial frame (kernel-checked)
nodes.claim: The F2^6 hexagram board and the Z6^2 Weyl board (12 lines, almost-disjoint cap at 3, 24 maximal triples, CRT factorization), with a Lean companion.
nodes.known_weaknesses: Combinatorial layer is kernel-checked; the analytic chain is not yet in Lean (brick B4).

nodes.title: No naive degree-4/6 SOS certificate
nodes.claim: No degree-4 and no degree-6 SOS certificate exists for W - f in the naive cone (exact separating functionals), forcing the X-space/transport route.
nodes.known_weaknesses: Refers to the naive cone; says where the method must be stronger, not that no SOS proof exists in any cone.

nodes.title: T1 global upper bound open
nodes.claim: The matching global upper bound for W(T1) is not yet established; T1 is one-sided (attainment only). T0 and T1 walls live in different fields.

nodes.title: d=10 wall has no closed form yet
nodes.claim: The d=10 wall is measured (defect ~ 0.0225) at high precision, but a PSLQ closed-form hunt found nothing and no structural obstruction is proven.

nodes.title: d=24 aligned-room ceiling not yet exact
nodes.claim: The aligned 3x8 product room tests the ceiling-law prediction 21/23 numerically; an exact confirmation/refutation is open.
